meta.title: Add Python stub file generation with documentation parsing
meta.body_summary: Add Python stub file (.pyi) generation for LVGL MicroPython, with parallel documentation parsing to provide IDE autocompletion and type hints; claims 6 seconds vs minutes build time.

perf_labels.notes: Claude_Code generated a large stubs tool with narrative performance claim; maintainer reviewed code structure and naming conventions, author is addressing feedback in draft PR.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 6651 changed lines across 16 files, this is a medium-to-large code generation PR by absolute volume, with the bulk (3984 lines) in a newly generated stubs file. It is still open pending review feedback; maintainer requested structural and naming changes rather than performance evidence.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer PGNetHun emphasized that AI-generated code often contains inaccuracies and requested separation of stubs generation into gen_stubs.py, moving search dirs to a constant, and using uppercase make target naming conventions. Author andrewleech agreed to make changes.
review_details.performance_claim: Parallel processing reduces stub generation time from minutes to 6 seconds using all CPU cores.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A large AI-produced build‑tool contribution requires extensive human code review; maintainer flagged structural issues (naming, file organization, auxiliary AI artifacts) and stressed the need for manual verification before merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed the PR and left inline comments on naming conventions (make target casing), AI-generated file presence (CLAUDE.md), incorrect build command, and code organization (separate gen_stubs.py, move search dirs to constant).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR provides build steps and output statistics but no timing benchmark or before/after comparison; performance claim is narrative only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Author has acknowledged all review points and indicated plans to remove CLAUDE.md, split generation logic, and rename build target.

core_change_summary.description: Added Python stub file generation to the LVGL MicroPython binding build, including a parallel documentation parser for 209 header files, a new gen_stubs.py module, and build targets; refactored stub generation from gen_mpy.py into separate modules and adjusted naming conventions.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: CLAUDE.md and LVGL_DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md are AI development artifacts not intended for commit; author agreed to remove them.
change_trajectory: First commit (45373766): Added initial stub generation code within gen_mpy.py, package structure, build targets.
Second commit (f8918f4): Added LVGL JSON generation for enhanced bindings.
Third commit (0e8f6ea): Refactored stub generation into separate gen_stubs.py and gen_utils.py, removed code from gen_mpy.py, renamed stubs directory, added generated lvgl.pyi.

review_signals.summary: Requested uppercase make target 'LVGL_STUBS' and following existing naming conventions.
Identified CLAUDE.md as AI-generated file and expressed concern about AI-generated correctness.
review_signals.action_taken: Author agreed to remove CLAUDE.md and other development notes before taking out of draft.

review_signals.summary: Requested moving stub generation into separate gen_stubs.py module and extracting search dirs as a constant array.
review_signals.action_taken: Author agreed to refactor and will implement the changes.

review_signals.summary: Explained that PR was left in draft for manual cleanup and that Claude Code assisted with high-quality design acceleration.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created by Andrew Leech with significant Claude Code assistance.
Over a month later, maintainer PGNetHun left multiple inline comments on naming, code structure, and AI-generated concerns.
Author responded promptly, agreed to all suggestions, and is preparing revisions.
